title: Six-domain label and shape
hints: Use geometry of all domains for the label.
Use only bonded atoms for the molecular shape.
Compare the result with each choice and check its sign, units, or underlying rule.
solution: Six domains give the course label $sp^3d^2$. Two opposite lone pairs leave a square-planar molecule.
statement:
Which pair describes the standard course label and molecular geometry of $\ce{XeF4}$?

[_]{a}

explanations: Six domains, four bonded neighbors in a plane.
This leaves out the Xe lone pairs.
This would require five domains and one lone pair.
Octahedral is the parent geometry; only four atoms are bonded.
